findings.one_line: The realization theorem is plausibly theorem-level novel, but its positioning must add a substantive closest-result comparison (including the accepted in-repository LiNG ExactID result) and explain why that structural-direction frontier does not anticipate a complete stable-orbit counting realization.

The related-work prose does not give a relevance-and-difference sentence for the cited perfect-matching/local-discovery work (notably Uno and Dai et al.); the comparator table's unmatched entry is not substantive positioning for this delivered enumerator.

The FOBI confidence-image theorem needs targeted prose distinguishing its orbit-symmetrized inversion from the cited FOBI, set-inversion, and discontinuous-functional literatures (Miettinen et al., Chernozhukov--Hong--Tamer, and Pfanzagl), rather than only naming the FOBI limit generically.

The confidence image is only an uncountable set image {N_stab(R): R in K_m}; supply an explicit finite algorithm or named optimization/quantifier-feasibility formulation for computing its attainable integer values so the advertised count-inference conclusion is usable.
